summary: Community member urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure reliable broadband access for students and schools.

claims.argument: E-Rate is essential infrastructure for modern public education, supporting both daily operations and learning.
claims.evidence_quote: Morton High School Dist 201 has received $1.38 million in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $275,351 a year toward the connections our students depend on. That support does not represent a one-time build; it is the recurring cost of keeping a modern network running.
